description: Determines whether an AI agent can actually discover and parse a store: whether robots.txt permits each major AI crawler by name, whether a sitemap, llms.txt, product feed or MCP endpoint exists, and whether the catalogue is machine readable. Use this when asked why a store never appears in AI assistants or agent shopping results.

url.description: The store's domain, for example example.com.

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check whether AI shopping agents can find and read a store
